summaryZh: Ecker 实验室研究植物、小鼠和人细胞发育及疾病中的表观遗传过程。团队结合基因组与甲基化组测序等方法，研究表观基因组变化及其与基因表达调控的联系，其中小鼠和人类工作大量聚焦脑。
researchQuestions: 在DNA上添加甲基或羟甲基等基团如何帮助细胞精细调控基因表达？
基因组与表观基因组如何相互通信？

evidence.quote: The Ecker lab studies plant, mouse, and human cells to decipher epigenetic processes during development and disease. Combining newly developed methods with genome- and methylome-sequencing, Ecker’s lab group examines changes in the epigenome
Much of the team’s work on mouse and human epigenomics is focused on the brain.

Combining newly developed methods with genome- and methylome-sequencing, Ecker’s lab group examines changes in the epigenome, exploring, for example, how adding molecules such as methyl or hydroxy-methyl groups to the backbone of DNA can help cells fine-tune gene expression.
By understanding how the genome and epigenome communicate with one another, they aim to untangle the complexity of regulatory processes that underlie both normal development and disease.
